node.statement: Finite-polyhedron presentation. Choose a homeomorphism h from breve-calU onto a finite simplicial complex K supplied by lem-stage1-bound-quotient-index-data, regard K as its finite polyhedron, and conjugate breve-sigma to f=h o breve-sigma o h^{-1}:K->K. Under the singleton hypothesis Fix(f)={h(breve-e)}; lem-finite-polyhedron-maximal-simplex-placement puts h(breve-e) in a maximal simplex. Cohomological naturality under h gives L(f)=L(breve-sigma), and the local fixed-point index is invariant under this conjugate presentation, so ind(f,h(breve-e))=ind(breve-sigma,breve-e)=+1.
